tile.in_numbers: Wellcome-funded research is open to everyone. In 2025, 95% of Wellcome-funded journal articles were free to read, and 72% of the research covered by the policy was in Europe PMC under an open license, as the policy requires.

comparison.preprint_growth: Wellcome-funded researchers are sharing their findings sooner. They posted 4,694 preprints in 2025, 77% more than in 2024.

trend.das_share: More Wellcome-funded researchers are saying where their data can be found. In 2025, 82% of journal articles included a data availability statement, up from half in 2020.
